campgrounds.name: Lower Lehman Creek Campground
campgrounds.description: Developed campground near Lehman Creek. Open year-round subject to conditions; no hookups or campground potable water.

campgrounds.name: Upper Lehman Creek Campground
campgrounds.description: Seasonal developed campground. No hookups or campground potable water; check reservations and vehicle limits.

campgrounds.name: Baker Creek Campground
campgrounds.description: Seasonal developed campground along Baker Creek Road. No hookups or campground potable water.

campgrounds.name: Red Rock Canyon Campground
campgrounds.region: Red Rock Canyon National Conservation Area
campgrounds.description: Developed BLM campground on Moenkopi Road with tent and RV sites, no hookups. Reservations and seasonal rules apply.

campgrounds.name: Cathedral Gorge State Park Campground
campgrounds.description: 22 campsites with tables, grills and shade ramadas. Electric hookups available; water, flush toilets and showers. Camp only in designated sites.

campgrounds.name: Wheeler Peak Campground
campgrounds.description: Seasonal high-elevation developed campground near the end of Wheeler Peak Scenic Drive. RV and trailer maximum length 24 feet; no hookups or campground potable water.
campgrounds.accessNotes: RV and trailer maximum 24 feet per NPS

campgrounds.name: Grey Cliffs Campground
campgrounds.description: Seasonal developed campground. Narrow one-way dirt roads; RVs and trailers are not permitted. No hookups or campground potable water.
campgrounds.accessNotes: No RVs or trailers per NPS
